steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Enable the required tenant configuration before starting the create flow.
Enable the required tenant configuration for the case.
Disable the tenant setting required by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ and establish the configuration context.
Provide the mandatory event title without affecting the configuration-cancel behavior.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Reopen the RFQ configuration window after configuring the product.

args.goal: click Cancel in the Configuration for Event window and stop on the Single Stage RFQ create screen with the configuration window closed and the existing event form unchanged

steps.note: Perform the unavailable Cancel interaction and verify on screen that the configuration window closes without changing the form.
Assert that the configuration window is closed.
